definition: `PerfectIn x p`: x is perfect in respect of the perfection p, that is, nothing is lacking to x according to the mode of that perfection (ST I q.4 a.1 co.). In Lean `PerfectIn` is a parameter, fixed only by STMT-DESIRABLE-INSOFAR-AS-PERFECT and STMT-PERFECT-INSOFAR-AS-IN-ACT; it is not universal perfection (DEF-UNIVERSALLY-PERFECT) and not the ultimate perfection that makes a thing perfect simpliciter (q.5 a.1 ad 1).
